subject: Re: Kickoff: flare removal for the imaging pipeline
body:
Lucia — resourcing.

Staffing: Tereza 50%, Farah 40%, Yusuf 30% until June then 50% for the feasibility work. And Rafael Duran is committed at 60% to this project for July 2026 — the pre-read lands Jul 3 and the quality bar for the imaging pipeline sits with him, so July is exactly when we need his depth on data and perceptual evals.

Compute: retraining needs 32 A100s for roughly three weeks in May — titan best-effort should hold, and vulcan's Jun 22-24 maintenance doesn't affect us. Data: capturing our own flare stacks with production lens profiles needs the optics lab for two weeks — booked from Apr 20.

One flag: the training-code history Lucia mentioned makes the Apr 24 repro milestone genuinely load-bearing. If current code doesn't reach published quality we escalate immediately rather than debugging silently into May.

Alina
